newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks end on sharp loss on Dow struggles.
newsitem.headline: French stocks end on sharp loss on Dow struggles.

text.p: French shares suffered heavy losses at the close, unsettled by Wall Street's drop, traders said.
Paris had been retracing some of its sharp retreat as it looked as the Dow was steadying but by the close, New York was still under pressure as U.S. treasuries weakened.
Sentiment has been nervy since last Friday's dive following Fed chairman Alan Greenspan's comment on over-exuberant markets
The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed down 38.12 points or 1.69 percent at 2,213.28, while the CAC-40 futures contract was down 42 at 2,215 from Tuesday's close.

* Pharmaceuticals sector excites trading interest, following Hoechst's 18.1 billion franc bid for full control of Roussel-Uclaf. Roussel was suspended, after closing on Tuesday at 1,439. The offer is at 1,530 francs per common stock.
* Synthelabo firms 2.97 percent to 520 francs, while Sanofi sheds 1.77 percent to 472.5, on prospects industry restructuring moves will continue.
* Rhone-Poulenc eases 0.9 percent to 165.30, limiting losses as fund managers buy stock to make up for Roussel shares to be tendered in the Hoechst offer.
* Carrefour outperformed the market, falling 0.94 percent to 3,150 francs. The retailer said it has bought 33.34 percent of GMB, which controls the Cora hypermarkets and supermarkets group.

* Retailers have attracted merger speculation since the takeover of Docks de France by Auchan. Casino gained 2.08 percent to 236, Promodes fell 1.69 percent to 1,392, Comptoir Modernes rose 2.47 percent to 2,700.
* President Jacques Chirac standing in latest opinion poll falls to 44 from 46 percent, Prime Minister Juppe also falls to 31 from 34 percent.
